response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS ar FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.n) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(g.rate - a.ar) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.rate > a.ar

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status average rates (each status counts once), not the mean over all individual scans.
Rows with a NULL healtheval form their own group and count as a status. SQLite GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group.

Per-scan rate is gbsize/spanmin. Rows with NULL values, or with spanmin = 0 (which gives NULL in SQLite), are ignored in the rate average. The distinct site count covers all matched scans in the status, including those without a rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude sites whose healtheval is NULL, so only named statuses are treated as statuses.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.healtheval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS ar FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.n) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(g.rate - a.ar) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.rate > a.ar
